target_customer: SaaS, AI and API companies with usage-based or hybrid pricing that outgrew home-built billing
problem: Engineering teams rebuild billing in-house because off-the-shelf tools were too rigid for usage-based pricing. Lago offers an open-source metering and billing engine.
business_model: Open source core (AGPLv3) with paid Lago Cloud and premium self-hosted features
product_category: Usage-based billing and metering platform (open source)

founders.name: Anh-Tho Chuong
founders.background_notes: YC page: first employee at Qonto and later VP Growth.

founders.name: Raffi Sarkissian
previous_startups: Unnamed earlier startup (YC page says second-time founder)
founders.background_notes: Led Data Operations at Qonto per the YC page.

competitors.name: Stripe Billing
competitors.what: Subscription and invoicing product inside Stripe, positioned by Lago as the alternative it replaces
competitors.traction_then: Default choice for many SaaS companies

competitors.name: Chargebee
competitors.funding_then: 125M Series G in April 2021, about 230M total

technical_complexity.rationale: Event ingestion, metering at scale, invoicing, taxes and payment connectors are standard engineering with hard scale and correctness requirements.

defensibility.rationale: Billing is deeply integrated once adopted, and open source builds trust. The code is open, so rivals can copy features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents offer usage billing, and third-party commentary notes pressure from bundled platforms. No acquisition of Lago found.

market_need_then: Usage-based pricing was growing among SaaS and API companies, and the founders say they repeatedly tried to replace home-grown billing and found nothing flexible enough (Launch HN, 2023).

branding.domain_note: Uses getlago.com, a get prefix, rather than lago.com

identity.logo: A third party page describes an orange sphere mark
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct engineering voice with blog posts such as why we chose open source

branding.community_and_virality: Product of the day and week on Product Hunt (April 2023) and a Launch HN thread in February 2023; over 9,000 GitHub stars per YC page.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong developer awareness through GitHub and Product Hunt, but the name is a common Spanish and Italian word and the domain needs a prefix.

outcome_analysis: Lago took the open-source route in a crowded billing market, gaining developer attention in early 2023 and raising a 15 million dollar Series A in March 2024 with total funding reported near 22 million. It rides the shift to usage-based and AI pricing while facing Stripe and well-funded rivals. No exit as of the latest sources.
notes: Seed date not found. Valuation of about 100M reported by one aggregator only, not recorded. Competitor sources are dated 2023, after the batch (Summer 2021), because Lago's public launch was 2023; these rivals existed before 2021 as established vendors. Technical flag: the getlago.com about page fetch was rate limited. Total 22M matches company description on the YC page. Chargebee competitor is dated April 2021 from TechCrunch; Stripe Billing and Recurly sources are from 2023 and the vendors predate the batch.
